items.4w1_d_0: Look at these words: dog, the, runs. Can you make a sentence?
items.4w1_d_2: Great! Now make it a question.
items.4w1_copy: My brother reads every day. Does he read comic books? Sit down and listen, please. What a fast runner he is!
items.4w2_d_0: This is a box. Look, it has an old key inside.
items.4w2_d_1: Wow! Is it the same key from yesterday?
items.4w2_d_2: Yes, it's the key. I have two more boxes at home.
items.4w2_d_3: Let's make labels for all the boxes!
items.4w2_copy: I have a red box. It has an old toy inside. The toy is my favorite one. I keep many toys in boxes.
items.4w3_d_1: He is my brother. His name is Sam.
items.4w3_d_3: Yes, it's his. But this pen is mine.
items.4w3_copy: This is my friend Ben. He is funny and kind. Her name is Grace. These pencils are hers, not mine.
items.4w4_d_1: Yes, I am tired. But I still play basketball.
items.4w4_d_2: I am hungry. I eat lunch now.
items.4w4_d_3: Good idea! I eat lunch, too.
items.4w4_copy: My dog is small. It runs and jumps a lot. I am happy today. I play with my dog every day.
items.4w5_d_0: Here are three word cards: he, is, happy. Make a sentence.
items.4w5_copy: The box is heavy. Is the box heavy? Please open the box. What a big box!
items.4w6_d_1: Yes, it is clean. My bed and my lamp are tidy.
items.4w6_d_2: Good. Please share your toys with your sister.
items.4w6_d_3: OK. Rule one: be quiet after nine.
items.4w6_g_1: It has a big bed and a small lamp.
items.4w6_copy: My room has a bed, a lamp, and a small desk. I clean it every weekend. My rule is simple: keep it tidy. My sister must knock before she comes in.
items.4w7_d_1: My favorite sport is swimming. Can you swim?
items.4w7_d_2: Yes, I can! What is your hobby?
items.4w7_g_3: Yes, I can. I practice every day.
items.4w7_copy: I interviewed my friend Leo today. His favorite sport is swimming. He can swim very fast. His hobby is playing basketball.
items.4w8_d_1: Almost. Let me check my sentences.
items.4w8_d_2: Good habit! Did you fix the mistake in sentence three?
items.4w8_d_3: Yes, I fixed it. Now it is my own page.
items.4w8_g_1: It is about my family and my room.
items.4w8_g_3: I fix the mistakes I find.
items.4w8_copy: My world page has four parts: family, room, friend, and hobby. Each sentence has a subject and a verb. I checked my nouns and pronouns. Now my page is ready to share.
